title: Prometheus remote write

fields.name: add_label
fields.description: This lets you add custom labels to all metrics sent by the prometheus_remote_write output. You can have multiple of these fields.

fields.name: aws_auth
fields.description: Enable AWS SigV4 authentication.

fields.name: aws_external_id
fields.description: External ID for the AWS IAM Role specified with aws_role_arn, used by SigV4 authentication.

fields.name: aws_profile
fields.description: AWS profile name. AWS profiles can be configured with AWS CLI and are usually stored in $HOME/.aws/.

fields.name: aws_region
fields.description: Region of your Amazon Managed Service for Prometheus workspace.

fields.name: aws_role_arn
fields.description: AWS IAM Role to assume, used by SigV4 authentication.

fields.name: aws_service
fields.description: AWS destination service code, used by SigV4 authentication. For Amazon Managed Service for Prometheus, the service name is aps.

fields.name: aws_sts_endpoint
fields.description: Specify the custom STS endpoint to be used with STS API, used with the aws_role_arn option, used by SigV4 authentication.

fields.name: compression
fields.description: Payload compression algorithm. Supported options: snappy, gzip, zstd.

fields.name: header
fields.description: Add a HTTP header key/value pair. Multiple headers can be set.

fields.name: host
fields.description: IP address or hostname of the target HTTP server.

fields.name: http_passwd
fields.description: Basic Auth password. Requires http_user to be set.

fields.name: http_user
fields.description: Basic Auth username.

fields.name: log_response_payload
fields.description: Log the response payload within the Fluent Bit log.

fields.name: port
fields.description: TCP port of the target HTTP server.

fields.name: proxy
fields.description: Specify an HTTP proxy. The expected format of this value is http://HOST:PORT. HTTPS isn't supported. Configure the HTTP proxy environment variables instead as they support both HTTP and HTTPS.

fields.name: uri
fields.description: Specify an optional HTTP URI for the target web server, for example /someuri.

fields.name: workers
fields.description: The number of workers to perform flush operations for this output.

fields.name: match
fields.description: Tag match pattern used to route records to this plugin. Supports '*' wildcard matching.

fields.name: match_regex
fields.description: Regular expression tag match used to route records to this plugin. Takes precedence over match when both are set.

description: Fluent Bit output plugin: Prometheus remote write.
